eventBanner.closeBody: Closes this panel. The game keeps running.
eventBanner.vip: The Cat Burglar is on the next ferry
eventBanner.ruckus: Ruckus: mood too low, work stopped
eventBanner.foodBody: Tap each brawler to calm them. If the meter fills ({sec} s), the canteen closes for 30 s and gets dirty. Guards nearby help.
eventBanner.tunnelBody: Tap the escapee before they reach the fence: +coins and reputation. An escape costs reputation. Tap this chip to fly there.
eventBanner.vipBody: A famous guest with a high escape risk. Release him for a 5× bounty. Keep guards near the fence.
